/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/ulta-gh.description: Ulta Ghar is an upside-down house for children aged 3 to 8, built around a drop climber that surprises children the first time they find it. A tall tower with a green tube slide stands beside the tilted house, so one group can climb while another slides down. Up to 15 children can play at once within a safe play area of 17'11" x 16'8". Play on Ulta Ghar involves sliding and climbing, and it builds coordination, cooperative play, creativity and confidence with height. It belongs to our Nature Sparsh collection, comes in Forest Green, and carries a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Ask us for a layout drawing and a quote for your school, society or park.
